summary.headline: Mercury Combustion in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological omens from the combustion of Mercury in Gemini, Cancer, and Leo, including predictions about disease, death, weather, prices, crops, rulers, merchants, scribes, warfare, and travel according to planetary conjunctions or aspects. Ahmad ʿAbd al-Jalil is cited among the authorities.
